name: Tama
source:
Likes: Destroying the dreams of many people
Dislikes: The wild, the city

Nagi's pet tiger she found when he was a cub and in her trip around Africa. He likes teasing Hayate. Tama also enjoys the super rich life style that he would not accept ordinary food but Matsuzaka beef and expensive tuna fish. He is also able to speak the human language though very few like Hayate and Wataru knows of this. He has been known to imitate other people's voices, and has done a perfect imitation of Nagi once.
